'''Kevin Seraphin''' (born December 7, 1989) is a [[France|French]] [[basketball]] player. He is currently playing for [[Cholet Basket]] in the French [[Ligue Nationale de Basketball]]. A native of [[Cayenne]] in [[French Guiana]], Seraphin is {{convert|2.05|m|ftin|abbr=on|lk=off}} and weighs {{convert|113|kg|lb|abbr=on|lk=off}}.

Seraphin has been named to the All-Tournament team of the [[FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship 2009]], after helping France to win the silver medal.
